visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a black baseball cap and a cream-colored t-shirt is shown eating noodles enthusiastically. He uses black chopsticks to lift a large portion of ramen from a white ceramic bowl. Large white and yellow text overlays the screen in a graphic style. The setting is a professional kitchen with stainless steel surfaces and hanging pots visible in the background. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a steaming bowl of ramen topped with fresh green onions, thinly sliced beef, and red chili flakes. The lighting is bright and highlights the texture of the broth and ingredients. (3) The man stands in the kitchen, pointing directly at the camera while speaking. He is wearing a white glove on his right hand. A black hat with a logo and a watch are clearly visible. (4) Hands in white gloves pour dried red chilies and Sichuan peppercorns from a small metal cup into an electric grinder. The camera captures the detailed texture of the spices. (5) The man attempts to press the button on the grinder, but nothing happens. He looks puzzled, then realizes it is unplugged. He laughs, showing his teeth, and plugs the black power cord into an outlet. (6) The grinder is activated, showing the lid vibrating as the spices are pulverized into a fine red powder. The powder is then poured into a small stainless steel bowl. (7) A pot of water is seen boiling on a stove. The man tears open a red packet of Shin Ramyun seasoning and pours the contents into a large white bowl. (8) Hot water and cooked noodles are added to the bowl. The man uses chopsticks to stir the mixture. He then meticulously layers raw, marbled beef slices on top of the noodles. (9) A blue flame from a handheld blowtorch is directed at the beef, searing the meat until it turns brown and slightly charred. (10) Chopped garlic, a generous amount of green onions, the freshly ground chili powder, and another sprinkle of red seasoning are added to the bowl in layers. (11) The man holds the finished bowl of ramen close to the camera, using chopsticks to lift the noodles and beef to show the viewer. He speaks with an expressive face, looking directly at the lens. (12) The man takes a large bite of the ramen, nodding his head in satisfaction. The final shot shows him continuing his explanation while holding the bowl.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 即食品. [Slogan]: 升級術. (2) [Subtitle]: 韓國 辛拉麵. (3) [Subtitle]: 怎麼樣讓 泡麵 升級. (4) [Subtitle]: 教你怎麼煮. (5) [Subtitle]: 辣椒. (6) [Subtitle]: 花椒. (7) [Subtitle]: 打碎. (8) [Subtitle]: 沒電！. (9) [Subtitle]: 忘記插電. (10) [Subtitle]: 打碎即可. (11) [Subtitle]: 煮麵. (12) [Subtitle]: 準備調味粉包. (13) [Subtitle]: 倒入煮麵水. (14) [Subtitle]: 放入麵 拌一拌讓它入味. (15) [Subtitle]: 肉再舖上去. (16) [Subtitle]: 炙燒一下. (17) [Subtitle]: 倒湯進來. (18) [Subtitle]: 蒜碎 蔥花. (19) [Subtitle]: 剛剛的辣椒粉 十三香辣椒粉. (20) [Subtitle]: 好等一下 我泡一下. (21) [Subtitle]: 好香 因為辛拉麵其實 那包粉 是重點. (22) [Subtitle]: 像你看 台灣很多的泡麵 都有油包 對不對. (23) [Subtitle]: 台灣人講求的是. [Variety]: 油香味. (24) [Subtitle]: 是不是很簡單 如果今天 韓國人 你有看到跟我一樣是 贊牌的 我們就可以說 這個做法是 台灣的 但是 地瓜是韓國的 因為 韓籍. (25) [Subtitle]: 真的多了那個油香味 變好香喔 好好香.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male chef wearing a cream t-shirt, a black baseball cap, a metal wristwatch, and white disposable gloves during food preparation.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A professional-looking indoor kitchen with stainless steel countertops, industrial shelving holding various pots, pans, and kitchen appliances, and a framed picture on the wall.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced electronic pop music starts immediately with the sound of someone loudly slurping noodles. The speaker begins with a high-energy greeting. (2) A metallic clinking sound is heard as dried spices are poured into a container. (3) A sudden 'click' followed by silence in the voice track occurs as the speaker realizes the power is off, accompanied by a comedic pause and then lighthearted laughter. (4) A loud, continuous high-frequency buzzing sound from an electric grinder dominates for three seconds. (5) Bubbling water sounds and the crisp rustle of plastic seasoning packets being torn open are layered over the music. (6) A sharp hissing sound of a pressurized blowtorch flame begins and lasts for about four seconds, with the pitch fluctuating as the torch moves. (7) Rapid clinking of a metal spoon against a ceramic bowl occurs as garnishes are added. (8) The speaker's narration becomes more explanatory and rhythmic, synced with the beat of the music. (9) A final slurping sound is heard, followed by a soft 'ding' effect to mark the conclusion of the video.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Technique Explanation -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate a specific 'upgrade' method for instant ramen by adding fresh ingredients and focusing on creating a 'Taiwanese-style' oil fragrance, while maintaining a humorous and energetic tone.
